items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: Well we went with King Oliver... On trombone we had one, we had Kid Ory on trombone.

ctx.x: Yes, we talked to him up and he's in Baton Rouge. We saw him last January. Last January.

Well we went with King Oliver. Let's see, I think I can remember some of the names in that band. It was pretty long ways back. But on trumpet there, they had King Oliver. They had a trumpet player called Gray. So far I can't remember his name. He was Gray and Red Allen. It was three trumpets. On trombone we had one, we had Kid Ory on trombone. Now on bass we had a fellow, but his name was Buford. That's all I can remember. Buford, heavy dog. Buford, he was a bass player. On saxophone we had Omar Simeon. I think…
Just a week and a half ago.

items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: I've played with Johnny Sincere and Kid Ory. Kid Ory was our trombone player when we went to New York.

ctx.x: I mean I think it's really hard for now. Well I've had quite a bit of experience in music. I've played with so many of the great musicians. I've played with Johnny Sincere and Kid Ory. I forgot to tell you about the trombone player.
Kid Ory was our trombone player when we went to New York. Oh at the Savoy? At the Savoy Ballroom.
Yeah I forgot to mention him.
